source_name: Gorenjska banka – novice / blog
why_relevant: Gorenjska banka (AIK Banka group) publishes flat-slug news articles on rebranding for the digital era, new digital banking experience and instant payments go-live — explicit customer-facing launch records with dates.

source_name: Addiko Bank Slovenija – Obvestila za stranke
why_relevant: Addiko's customer-notices stream is where channel and product go-lives land (e.g. fully online loan origination built on the state SI-PASS eID service). Notices often name the enabling service/provider that a press release would omit.

source_name: Delavska hranilnica – Obvestila (o hranilnici)
why_relevant: The largest Slovenian savings bank and an unusually fast digital mover (first to enable Flik payments to online merchants; staged rollout of the redesigned DH Mobilni app). Its notices document savings-bank-tier vendor choices that never appear in English.

source_name: Delavska hranilnica – official Facebook page
why_relevant: DH pre-announces releases on social before the website notice (observed teaser post for the renewed mobile bank). Social posts often carry earlier dates and looser wording that mentions partners.

source_name: Banka Intesa Sanpaolo (Slovenija) – Digitalno bančništvo & corporate pages
why_relevant: Bilingual site; the digital-banking section plus its dated T&C and user-manual PDFs are a de-facto changelog of the bank's digital platform, and the corporate pages describe the group transformation plan driving vendor spend.

source_name: SID banka – official site (news / financing-for-digitalisation pages)
why_relevant: State-owned promotional/development bank. Two roles for this cell: it is itself a buyer of banking technology, and via products such as SID DIGITALEN it funds digitalisation at other institutions — a partnership-adjacent signal.

source_name: Deželna banka Slovenije – mDBS mobile bank & e-banking pages
why_relevant: Domestically-owned mid-tier bank (cooperative/agricultural roots). Its e-banking pages document the mDBS app and the third-party services it rides on (Flik, Rekono OnePass) — typical of smaller SI institutions that buy shared platforms rather than build.

source_name: Primorska hranilnica Vipava – official site
why_relevant: Small savings bank; adopter of shared national rails (Flik, Rekono OnePass). Low volume but essential for completeness of the buyer-side census — small institutions reveal which shared/outsourced platforms dominate the tail of the market.

source_name: Hranilnica LON – official site (news / ownership change)
why_relevant: Savings bank reported as an acquisition target (Sparkasse and Deželna banka named as interested). Ownership change is a classic trigger for platform migration, so its newsroom should be watched for consolidation-driven go-lives. URL inferred from the institution's known domain — treat as unverified until the liveness pass runs.

source_name: Banka Sparkasse d.d. (Slovenija) – official site / news
why_relevant: Austrian-owned SI bank, Flik adopter and reported acquirer candidate for Hranilnica LON. Buyer-side announcements here often mirror Erste/Steiermärkische group platform decisions. Domain inferred from the brand — unverified.

source_name: Združenje bank Slovenije (ZBS) – Sporočila za javnost in novice
why_relevant: The Slovenian Banking Association speaks for the collective buyer side and publishes releases from its IT-professionals conference ('posvet informatikov'), where member banks describe their technology programmes. Its annual report enumerates member institutions — a second authoritative actor list — and the news stream points to individual bank initiatives.

source_name: Wikipedija – Seznam bank v Sloveniji
why_relevant: Fast, free crosswalk of bank names, historical names and mergers (Abanka, Sberbank/N Banka, Nova KBM, SKB) — useful for building the alias table needed to search Slovenian newsrooms and to find archived pre-merger announcements.

source_name: Društvo Mali delničarji Slovenije (skupaj.si) – per-bank entity pages
why_relevant: Minority-shareholder association maintains taxonomy pages for essentially every SI bank and savings bank (NLB, Gorenjska, Addiko, SKB, BKS, DBS, Intesa, Delavska hranilnica, Primorska hranilnica, LON, SID, UniCredit), each aggregating contacts and news links. A convenient snowball hub to reach small institutions' own sites.

source_name: Siol.net – Posel danes (bank technology launch coverage)
why_relevant: Slovenian business news desk that reliably covers bank digital-channel launches, often as sponsored or bank-briefed articles (Flik rollouts, instant payments, which banks joined when). Frequently the only public record of which specific institutions went live on a shared platform and on what date.

source_name: SRC d.o.o. – InfoSRC revija, 'Digitalizacija v bankah'
why_relevant: A Slovenian IT integrator's magazine writing specifically about digitalisation in banks — the mirror image of the buyer-side record, naming bank projects from the supplier's side. Useful for reconciling a bank's own announcement with the implementer's account.

source_name: Na Prostem – 'Suverenost uporabnika slovenskih mobilnih in spletnih bank'
why_relevant: Independent technical audit-style comparison of Slovenian mobile/online banking apps across institutions. Reveals platform characteristics and third-party dependencies (SDKs, identity providers) that banks never announce — an indirect way to infer the vendor behind an app.

source_name: Delo / Podjetništvo – NLB digital solutions coverage
why_relevant: Slovenia's leading daily's business/finance vertical carries bank-briefed pieces on digital solutions and rankings (e.g. NLB among top global providers of financial-services innovation). Adds context and sometimes vendor names absent from the bank's own release.

source_name: RTV SLO – Gospodarstvo (public broadcaster business desk)
why_relevant: Non-paywalled public-broadcaster coverage of major banking events (the Nova KBM/SKB to OTP merger and what it means for customers' digital channels). Reliable, free corroboration layer for dating buyer-side changes.

source_name: Regional/local business news portals (Sobotainfo, Ptujinfo, Podjetna Slovenija)
why_relevant: Regional portals republish bank-supplied advertorials about new online/mobile banking and new business products nearly verbatim. Because they are unedited, they often preserve vendor and product detail that the bank's own polished release trims — and they are free of paywalls.

source_name: e-JN – Elektronsko javno naročanje (ejn.gov.si)
source_subtype: e-procurement transaction system with public case pages
why_relevant: The operational e-procurement system where tenders are run and bids submitted; its public 'aktualno' pages expose individual procurement cases with subject, contracting authority and timelines before award. Complements enarocanje.si by giving live pipeline visibility on banking/payments tenders.

source_name: TED – Tenders Electronic Daily (EU OJ Supplement)
why_relevant: All above-threshold Slovenian contracts (typical for card services, ATM fleets, core banking IT, cash-in-transit for state buyers) must also be published EU-wide. Section V of a contract award notice names the winner and value, and TED offers multilingual notice text including Slovenian.

source_name: TED Developer Docs – Search API v3
why_relevant: Documents the unauthenticated programmatic route into TED notices, which is the difference between manual notice reading and a sustainable longitudinal contract-award dataset for SI banking/payments.

source_name: Statist – aplikacija za statistiko oddanih javnih naročil (OPSI/MJU)
source_subtype: government analytics application over award data
why_relevant: Comprehensive, continuously updated publication of awarded public contracts in Slovenia from 1 Jan 2013 onward, with contracting authority, subject, procedure type and bidder identity. Gives a structured, queryable base for market sizing and vendor share in banking/payments-adjacent categories.

source_name: OPSI dataset – Zbirka obvestil v zvezi s postopki javnih naročil (Portal javnih naročil)
why_relevant: Bulk machine-readable collection of procurement notices behind the national portal — the cleanest way to enumerate and diff notices over time rather than scraping HTML.

source_name: OPSI dataset – Zbirka objavljenih odločitev o oddaji javnega naročila
why_relevant: Award decisions ('odločitve o oddaji') with portal publication number, TED number and contracting-authority data — the join key between the national portal, TED and the contract register. Award decisions frequently name the selected bidder before the formal award notice appears.

source_name: OPSI dataset – Pregled objavljenih pogodb po oddaji javnega naročila
source_subtype: open data bulk dataset / contract register
why_relevant: Published contracts after award — the deepest available layer of contract-level ground truth (actual scope, duration, price schedules) for state purchases of payment/banking services and IT.

source_name: OPSI dataset – Seznam aktualnih javnih naročil v IS e-JN
why_relevant: Live pipeline list (authority, subject, deadlines, bid-opening time, status) — early warning on upcoming banking/payments tenders before any award exists.
